# motion-pages — award-site motion, one prompt away

> Open-source Claude Code skill (MIT) that teaches an AI agent to build immersive,
> award-site-style Three.js landing pages as single self-contained HTML files —
> foggy hero worlds, glass product stages, dome media galleries, scroll-driven
> camera journeys with particle morphs — screenshot-verified across desktop,
> tablet and phone before shipping.

## Core

- [SKILL.md (the full skill — read this to build pages)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jiangyurong609/motion-pages/main/SKILL.md)
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jiangyurong609/motion-pages/main/README.md)
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/jiangyurong609/motion-pages)

## Live examples (view source for working reference code)

- [Sylva replica — foggy living-world hero, scan intro, creature](https://jiangyurong609.github.io/motion-pages/examples/sylva-replica.html)
- [Fernline — the hero applied to a fictional SaaS brand](https://jiangyurong609.github.io/motion-pages/examples/fernline-hero.html)
- [SONA·1 — glass product stage, fresnel shader, sonar rings](https://jiangyurong609.github.io/motion-pages/examples/sona-product-hero.html)
- [Archive° — drag-orbit dome gallery, click-to-focus camera flight](https://jiangyurong609.github.io/motion-pages/examples/dome-gallery.html)
- [BOREAL — scroll-scrubbed camera rail, particle shape morphs](https://jiangyurong609.github.io/motion-pages/examples/boreal-journey.html)
- [PURA — liquid-glass ripple typography, raw WebGL, no three.js](https://jiangyurong609.github.io/motion-pages/examples/pura-liquid-hero.html)
- [Paperworks* — springy draggable poster wall, pure DOM](https://jiangyurong609.github.io/motion-pages/examples/paperworks-posterwall.html)
- [VOLERA — particle shape morph: crane → V-flock → moon gate](https://jiangyurong609.github.io/motion-pages/examples/volera-morph.html)
- [TEMPO — the easing grammar as an interactive one-file reference](https://jiangyurong609.github.io/motion-pages/examples/tempo-easing.html)

## Usage

Install as a Claude Code skill (`cp -r motion-pages ~/.claude/skills/`), or paste
SKILL.md into any coding agent's context, then prompt e.g. "Build a 3D product
hero like AETHER — fresnel-glass case, sonar rings, orbital arcs. Self-verify
until perfect."
